acceptable_fixes: Release cpumask after __sink(cpumask) if cpumask is non-NULL.
Transfer the owned cpumask into a kptr/map in a verifier-accepted way so the program no longer owns it.
canonical_fix: After make_object returns a non-NULL cpumask, call bpf_cpumask_release(cpumask) before returning on every path that still owns it.
expected_explanation: make_object acquires an owned cpumask reference. The entry program stores/sinks it and returns without releasing or transferring ownership, so one exit path leaks the reference.

reasoning_profile.note: OpenRouter does not list reasoning controls for this model.

must_mention: An owned cpumask reference is acquired
Every exit path must release or transfer ownership
The NULL path does not need release

scoring.0: Unrelated or does not identify the verifier failure.
scoring.1: Broad area only, no actionable source-level fix.
scoring.3: Source-level fix likely to satisfy verifier, but imprecise.
scoring.4: Minimal intended fix or equivalent patch with correct reasoning.

wrong_if: Removes the acquisition without preserving the intended object use
Calls release without considering NULL when the API requires non-NULL
Releases only on an error path and still returns with ownership on success
